name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) hard requires reaching the goal, and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard enforces that the key is picked up first; together they force has_key, with no redundant extra clause.

texts: Only reach the goal after picking up the key
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 11
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
